jobs.occupation: Drivers Wanted for Our Transport Team
jobs.description:
We are looking for one new driver for our night shift with experience in tower transport or handling other large machinery, such as trucks, tractors, or construction equipment. As a driver on the night shift, your working hours will be as follows:

• 
Friday and Saturday: 07:00 – 19:00

• 
Monday to Thursday: 18:00 – 06:00

After one working week, you will have one week off in lieu, providing a good balance between work and leisure.

You will become part of a team of 9 other drivers, and experience with logistics and planning is an advantage. We are a company in strong development, facing an exciting future within the wind energy industry.

You will operate our large transport vehicles, including Fiona and Shrek, which are reach stackers with a capacity of 200 tonnes, as well as Rex, the world’s largest reach stacker with a capacity of 350 tonnes. Below you can read more about what we expect from you and what we as a company can offer.

We expect that you:

• 
Have experience transporting heavy items

• 
Hold a forklift certificate and a category B driving licence

• 
Crane basic and telescopic handler certificates are an advantage (not a requirement)

• 
Are reliable, flexible, and punctual

• 
Enjoy precision work and have a steady hand

• 
Are able to speak English at a basic, understandable level

We offer you:

• 
A workday involving the internal movement of large items at the factory

• 
A job in a company with a good working environment

• 
Health insurance and an employee association

• 
Employment in a company that values you as an employee

• 
An excellent canteen

Welcon A/S is part of CJ Holding, founded in 1993 by brothers Jens and Carsten Pedersen. The purpose of the company is to own businesses within the energy sector and related areas, with Welcon A/S being the largest company in the group. The group operates internationally, has an annual turnover of more than DKK 1 billion, and employs more than 800 people. The group is financially strong and has experienced significant development and growth in recent years.

Welcon A/S primarily produces towers and foundations for wind turbines, as well as other steel structures, at the factory’s nearly 120,000 m² production facilities in Give. We are known for delivering high-quality products and for being exceptionally service-minded towards our customers.

IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, WE CAN STEEL IT.

Application

Does this sound like something for you? Then please send your application to job@welcon.dk.

Applications are processed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled when the right candidates are found.

For further information, please contact:
Transport Manager

Mikkel Vraa
Email:MVR@welcon.dk
or job@welcon.dk

jobs.occupation: Gulvafslibere søges til en veletableret virksomhed / Floor sander wanted for a well-established company.
jobs.description:
SEE ENGLISH VERSION BELOW

RCC Byg er en veletableret virksomhed beliggende i Søborg, som gennem årene har leveret professionelle gulvbehandlinger til en bred vifte af kundetyper. Vi beskæftiger os med alt fra gulvafslibning til montering af trægulve.

Vi søger netop nu 1-2 erfaren kollegaer til vores gulvslibningsteam, som kan være med til at løse virksomhedens opgaveportefølje.

Har du erfaring som gulvsliber og er du passioneret omkring dit arbejde, så kan vi tilbyde dig en attraktiv arbejdsplads med højt humør!

Om jobbet:

Hos RCC Byg kommer du til at arbejde med gulvafslibning, polering og efterbehandling af trægulve, herunder bl.a. efterbehandling med olie, lud og sæbe.

Du vil blive tilknyttet en kollega, så I altid er to om opgaverne, ved små opgaver må man forvente at arbejde selvstændigt. Som makkerpar får I stillet en firmabil til rådighed med de nødvendige maskiner og værktøj.

Vi forventer, at du:

1.        Har minimum 1 års erfaring indenfor gulvafslibning

2.        Har kørekort B

3.        Er pligtopfyldende og letforståelig på engelsk eller dansk

4.        Afslutter en opgave ryddelig og kvalitetsbevidst

Vi tilbyder:

1.        Attraktiv løn

2.        Arbejdstid i tidsrummet 07:00-15:00

3.        Kollegaer du kan sparrer med

4.        Spændende og alsidige opgave

 
Lyder stillingen interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail info@rccbyg.dk 

Vi ser frem til din ansøgning og cv. Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

 

ENGLISH

RCC Byg is a well-established company located in Søborg (near Copenhagen) which over the years has delivered professional floor treatments to a wide range of customer types. We deal with everything from floor sanding to installing wooden floors.

We are currently looking for 1-2 experienced colleagues for our floor sanding team who can help solve the company's task portfolio.

If you have experience as a floor sander and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with high spirits!

About the job:

At RCC Byg, you will work with floor sanding, polishing and finishing of wooden floors, including e.g. finishing with oil, lye and soap.

You will be assigned to a colleague, so that there are always two of you on the tasks, with small tasks you must be expected to work independently. As a partner, you will be provided with a company car with the necessary machines and tools.

We expect you to:

1.        Has a minimum of 1 year of experience in floor sanding

2.        Have driving license B

3.        Obligatory and easy to understand in English or Danish

4.        Finishes a task in a tidy and quality-conscious manner 

We offer:

1.        Attractive salary

2.        Working hours in the period 07:00-15:00

3.        Colleagues you can spar with

4.        Exciting and versatile tasks

 

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions? You are very welcome to contact us at info@rccbyg.dk.

We look forward to your application and CV.

Interviews are conducted regularly with hiring as soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Wanted for GLS Express
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a flexible job with freedom under responsibility? We are looking for reliable and punctual delivery drivers to drive for GLS Express.

The job is similar to taxi driving – it is "point-to-point" (A to B) driving based on orders assigned to you along the way, and you will be driving all over Denmark. You will receive thorough training from the start so you feel completely confident.

Note: As an EU passport is required, we are exclusively looking for EU citizens. We have a dedicated team that will help you set up your personal registration number (CPR).

About the Job:

• 
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (free Saturdays and Sundays).

• 
Working Hours: Start at 07:00 and finish approximately between 15:00 and 18:00 (varies depending on the day's routes).

• 
Type of Driving: Point-to-point (A to B) orders across all of Denmark.

• 
Vehicle: You will work in a company vehicle.

• 
Salary: Approximately 18,000 - 20,000 DKK net (after tax).

• 
Housing Option: Possibility to rent housing in connection with the job (rent varies depending on the size of the apartment, approx. 3,500 - 5,000 DKK).

• 
Training: You will receive a thorough introduction and training in the system and tasks from day one.

• 
Arrival Assistance: We have a dedicated team to help you get your personal registration number (CPR) set up.

Requirements:

• 
EU Passport / EU Citizen: You must be a citizen of an EU country and hold a valid EU passport.

• 
Driver's License: Valid Category B driver's license (standard car license).

• 
Language: You must be able to understand and speak basic English.

• 
Personal Traits: You are 100% reliable, punctual, and responsible.

• 
Flexible: You thrive in an active daily routine and changing routes on the road.

Are you interested or do you have any questions? Send us a message on WhatsApp to learn more:

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

At Miele, we work every day on products and services that stand for uncompromising quality. We do this with people who take responsibility, collaborate across borders, and strive for continuous improvement. For our Western Europe cluster, we are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager with excellent people management skills.
Alongside your existing skills and experience, we're looking for engaged team players who will collaborate, innovate and use their passion to drive an exceptional customer experience at every touchpoint.
If you are the best at what you do and have bold ideas and ambitions for progressing your career with Miele we want to hear from you!

What you will be doing:
As Accounting Manager, you are responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of financial reporting and projects across the four markets of the cluster: Belgium, Luxemburg, France and the Netherlands. You ensure the quality, reliability and compliance of financial information, while developing a forward-looking perspective for the cluster. You oversee a team of accounting experts and work closely with local teams, regional finance, the international shared service center in Poland, and the global Miele organization

Key responsibilities:
Lead and develop a team of five (3 accounting officers and 2 credit controllers).
Strengthen capabilities, drive performance, and foster collaboration within the team, with the International Shared Service Center and across departments.
Lead the month-end and year-end closing financial processes .
Ensure timely, accurate and compliant reporting of financial data (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) in accordance with Miele guidelines and local legislation.
Act as the local point of contact for tax, legal and credit management related activities within the cluster.
Ensure transfer pricing and intercompany compliance in line with Group policies.
Act as Compliance Ambassador, safeguarding accounting integrity and financial governance.
Contribute to project design, coordinate central and local stakeholders, and drive harmonization of financial processes across the cluster.
Deliver pragmatic, value-driven solutions to operational needs.

Why you should choose this job at Miele:
At Miele, we are committed to talent, growth and sustainability. We are building a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone gets equal opportunities and can be the best version of themselves. Working from your talent makes you happy and gives you energy and desire to make a difference. Together, we develop innovative solutions that help the company succeed and make life easier for many households.

We offer you:
A permanent contract.
A competitive salary based on your experience and skills.
Flexible working hours, combined with remote working (2 days/week), to help you strike a good balance between work and leisure time.
Work location: HQ Le Blanc Mesnil, and the tools you need to work to the best of your ability.
A strong brand and a stable family business that attaches great importance to customer satisfaction.

The Accounting Manager we are looking for:
Proven knowledge of accounting, tax and legal matters in an international context.
Education in finance and accounting, preferably CFA, CPA, FA or equivalent.
5+ years of leadership experience and excellent people management skills.
Strong business acumen and a commercial mindset.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively.
Experience working in a multinational, multi-location and multilingual environment.
Comfortable operating within a matrix organization with diverse stakeholders.
Excellent command of English and French (both written and spoken at C1-level).
Professional, meticulous and collaborative communication style.

Would you like to join us on a quest for "Immer Besser" and further develop your career? Then apply now!

The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Reactor Division is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of ILL's high flux reactor. It oversees reactor operations, fuel management, maintenance, engineering, radiation protection, and technical support. The RDe employs around 100 people, mostly reactor operators and maintenance technicians and nuclear engineers, as well as safety, radiation protection and operations support staff.

We are looking for two mechanical maintenance technicians, who will join the group in charge of radioisotope production and maintenance of the equipment's in the Reactor Division. This group works on all of the reactor's handling facilities, as well as the irradiation processes for medical research.

Your tasks
-    Perform fuel-related handling operations: loading and unloading, replacement of water inside the fuel handling columns. 
-    Maintain the equipment that makes up the reactor's handling facilities: fuel handing columns, handling cranes and gantries, reactor pool gates. 
-    Perform all the operations relating to the production of radioisotope powders: encapsulation of ampoules, loading and unloading of capsules into and from the reactor, internal transport of irradiated capsules, cutting open of capsules in the hot cell, and conditioning of ampoules for shipment to European chemical processing centres. 
-    Operate and maintain the hot cells used to cut up irradiated equipment. 
-    Conduct periodic inspections and requalification of the pressure equipment used by the group (handling column valves, reactor valves, etc.). 
-    Manage maintenance sites from their preparatory phase through to completion of the work. 
-    Draft procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    Assist on an occasional basis with the operation of other equipment under the group's responsibility.
-    Maintain the power generators.

Desired profile
-    Level 5/6 qualification (BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial maintenance or equivalent.
-    First professional experience in industrial maintenance. 
-    Good writing skills for the drafting of procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    "Hands-on" approach and a very high level of autonomy. 
-    Strong analytical skills, team spirit, versatility, and the ability to use your initiative. 
-    Practical experience of carrying out maintenance in nuclear installations would be an advantage. 
-    Fluency in French is essential; knowledge of English would be appreciated.

?? Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts
